title: Daggerford: town-proper evidence and public-map survey

scope.rule: A roof group's representative point determines its survey boundary. The area inset is not a second inventory of the town.
scope.polygon_meaning: Approximate survey inclusion boundaries, not surveyed legal boundaries or precise wall footprints.

sources.title: Mike Schley — Fictional City Maps: Daggerford
sources.locator: Daggerford image and its adjoining caption; unpaginated web portfolio
sources.period: Map created for Scourge of the Sword Coast; the inspected caption does not specify a DR year
sources.summary: The artist identifies this as a top-down map of the walled town for Scourge of the Sword Coast and credits Wizards of the Coast.
sources.rights: Copyright Wizards of the Coast. Publicly displayed author preview used for local visual analysis; no redistribution license inferred.

sources.title: AideDD Faerûn atlas — Daggerford annotation

supports: Town and hinterland must not be conflated
Riverfront belongs in an economic map survey

sources.title: Search discovery: secondary discussion attributing 1,200 to SCAG
sources.locator: Rendered search-result excerpt, not the cited book or underlying discussion
sources.period: The discussion frames its comparison as 1492 DR; that attribution is not primary verification
sources.summary: A result attributes a Daggerford population of 1,200 to Sword Coast Adventurer's Guide. Neither the underlying discussion nor the book passage was available for verification.

population.revision_status: No independent, dated town census verified; retain the active model input without claiming validation

historical_evidence.status: Gazetteer snapshot on the analysis date, not historical source verification or a live override

historical_evidence.scope: Town attribution in an unverified secondary search excerpt
historical_evidence.status: Research lead only; source-specific boundary and book page unverified

limitations: The world date 1492 DR does not date an undated source or reconstruct population growth.
No verified year-specific 1357, 1372, or 1492 town count was acquired.
Rural residents are not automatically town residents or daily visitors; no commuting or market-day rate was measured.
Militia, garrison, servants, guild members and institutional residents can overlap the published population; do not add them to a town total without checking its scope.
The map's 40 numbered keys are places and repeated infrastructure categories, not 40 buildings, households or residents.

map.image_link_locator: Public js-lightbox data-src on the cartographer portfolio, not a guessed higher-resolution URL
map.coordinate_system: Original image pixels; origin top-left, x right, y down. North points LEFT, east UP.
map.sector_orientation: Audit sector names upper_west/lower_west/upper_east mean image-left/image-right tiling, NOT geographic west/east.

interpretations.description: Use the 0–100 inner ticks; intermediate ticks approximately agree. The terminal label would then be about 200, not its printed 150.
Honor the printed terminal 150 label; the inner tick labels then disagree.

scale.note: Neither interpretation is adopted as ground truth. Pixel observations remain usable; physical distances and areas are conditional, not measurements in feet.

map.survey_method: Manual visual pass over the entire town and immediate quays using enlarged crops; no OCR or target-population calibration. Representative roof-group points identify contiguous/associated roof masses, not legal parcels or exact ground-floor footprints.
map.coverage_status: Whole-scope visual pass with explicit unresolved small/attached roof groups and quayside symbols; not an exact building census

landmark_transcription_notes: Legend checked visually at enlarged resolution. Small-name spellings are provisional where the public preview cannot resolve individual letters; do not use these as authoritative entity aliases.
Keys 13, 16, 19, 23, 29, 31 and 36 require a higher-resolution source before authoritative lore normalization.
The index is retained independently of roof-group identities. Repeated keys 5 and 27 cannot be summed as single buildings.

roof_group_caveats.reason: Multi-wing or touching roof complex recorded once; could contain several buildings or uses. C06 includes the bank's west red annex; C46 is its separate north triangular roof.
Small or attached mass: independently visible roof divisions are not proof of independent buildings; grouping remains provisional.
Small quayside roof-like symbol; cargo, shed or other structure cannot be securely distinguished at this resolution.

unresolved_symbols.reason: Elongated object may be a hauled-out boat rather than a roof

exclusion_notes: Market tents, stalls, carts, wells, piers, moored boats, the wall walk, castle curtain walls and attached turret caps are not separate residential roof groups.
Castle corner towers are not individually counted as additional housing.
Infrastructure records are not added to the roof-group total.
No attempt is made to infer storeys, cellars, floor area, households or occupants from roof shading.
street_notes: Eleven street names were visually read, with route centerlines sketched on this particular map; the lines are not a complete routable network.
Not every street has a visible authoritative endpoint. Unnamed connecting lanes, private courtyards and market circulation are not invented as named streets.
The Shanties, Marketplace, Drill Field, Commons, Port and Caravan Grounds are area labels, not additional street names.
Duke's Way and Kauth Alley were checked in separate enlarged crops. Punctuation is transcribed as visible; no independent toponym authority was checked.

sensitivity.status: Illustrative occupancy sensitivity only, not an inferred town population or uncertainty interval
sensitivity.formula: eligible_roof_groups * residential_share * households_per_residential_group * occupied_unit_share * household_size; institutional residents and excluded/uncertain groups are NOT silently supplied
sensitivity.household_size_vocabulary: 4/5/6 is shared vocabulary with census.HOUSING_SCENARIOS, not evidence for Daggerford. No Waterdeep ward/class probabilities are transferred.
sensitivity.assumption_source: Analyst-authored round-number sensitivity inputs, independent of 900 or 1,200
limitations: Eligibility means only that a roof group is not explicitly excluded; it is not a residential classification.
Small/touching-roof identity uncertainty affects the denominator; scenarios cannot validate the inventory.
Business households and mixed-use buildings may be among eligible groups, but their occupancy is unknown.
Institutional/castle/garrison residents are unknown rather than zero. The displayed results are conditional non-institutional components, not town totals.
Realistic Daggerford occupancy priors, a residential-use audit and an independently consistent scale are still required for a defensible housing census.

blockers.detail: Forgotten Realms Wiki town and duchy pages returned HTTP 403. Oakthorne's Daggerford page returned HTTP 500. Accessible AideDD text has no numeric count.
D&D Beyond's Sword Coast Adventurer's Guide chapter URL redirected to its marketplace; the passage and page number were not verified. Do not promote the 1,200 search lead to a dated primary census.
Artist caption identifies the adventure but not a DR year; do not label this a 1492 census map.
Printed scale's 0–100 inner ticks and terminal 150 label disagree. No unique feet-per-pixel conversion adopted.
Public author image is 864×1210; small quayside objects and attached roof subdivisions remain ambiguous. Roof groups cannot establish buildings, households or residents.
